ranking.name: water kept aboard
ranking.why: closes every class on the drawn vehicle and bus at a price in delivered tonnes; no new mechanism; the price is bounded by routes.b.byKm.*.keptRangeT

ranking.name: hull balanced at half load, rotors both ways
ranking.why: closes the force balance for all classes on the drawn bus with full delivery, but changes the vehicle and gives up fail-safe float-up; the one next analysis

ranking.name: approach at airspeed
ranking.why: closes the moving legs for the P-100 and, at measured C_L, the P-1000; the hand-over to the bag has no coherent form at the drawn cable and hull lengths

ranking.name: variable displacement
ranking.why: ideal work is affordable only for the partial exchange; it asks sealed cells to change volume every cycle; closed by a reopenable design decision

ranking.name: rotor hold-down as drawn
ranking.why: the disk needed is a multiple of the hull planform on the two larger classes

ranking.name: cryogenic ballast
ranking.why: the energy and plant mass to make the ballast inside the cycle exceed the bus and the dry mass on every class with a gap
